        <script><![CDATA[var ProjectWorkspaceUtil = Class.create();

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getProperty = function(property, defaultValue) {
    var value = GlideApplicationProperty.getValue(property);
    return global.JSUtil.nil(value) ? defaultValue : value;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.convertColumnsObjectToArray = function(columnsObj) {
	let columns = [];
	if(!Array.isArray(columnsObj)) {
		for(const key in columnsObj) {
			columns.push(columnsObj[key]);
		}
		return columns;
	}
	return columnsObj;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getAllocateMoreThan24HoursProperty = function() {
	var sysProperties = new GlideRecord('sys_properties');
	sysProperties.get('sys_id','1c2e521077203110a12f78847a5a997e');
	return sysProperties.isValidRecord();
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.convertToStandardISOFormat = function(serviceNowIso) {
    return serviceNowIso.replace(' ', 'T');
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getSaveDataWithGlideRecordProp = function() {
    return ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getProperty(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.SAVE_DATA_WITH_GLIDE_RECORD, ProjectWorkspaceConstants.FALSE);
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getUserPreference = function(preference) {
    return gs.getUser().getPreference(preference);
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getFetchTasksBachSize = function() {
    return ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getProperty(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.FETCH_TASKS_BATCH_SIZE, 2000);
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getFetchResourceAllocationBachSize = () => {
    return parseInt(ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getProperty(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.FETCH_RESOURCE_ALLOCATION_BATCH_SIZE, 1000));
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getFetchResourceAssignmentBachSize = () => {
    return parseInt(ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getProperty(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.FETCH_RESOURCE_ASSIGNMENT_BATCH_SIZE, 5000));
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.isResourcePlanningEnabled = () => {
    const prop = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getProperty("sn_pw.enable_resource_planning", true);
    if (prop === true || prop === "true")
        return true;
    else
        return false;
};

//TODO: duplicated method of ProjectTaskUtil, change the ProjectTaskUtil access to public
ProjectWorkspaceUtil.isOpenOrPendingTaskInProject = function(field, sysId, taskType) {
    var plannedTaskStateUtil = new global.PlannedTaskStateUtil(taskType);
    var openStates = plannedTaskStateUtil.getOpenStates();
    var pendingStates = plannedTaskStateUtil.getPendingStates();
    var openOrPendingTask = false;
    openOrPendingTask = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getOpenOrPendingTasks(field, sysId, openStates, taskType);
    if (!openOrPendingTask) {
        openOrPendingTask = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getOpenOrPendingTasks(field, sysId, pendingStates, taskType);
    }
    return openOrPendingTask;
};

//TODO: duplicated method of ProjectTaskUtil, change the ProjectTaskUtil access to public
ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getOpenOrPendingTasks = function(field, sysId, states, taskType) {
    var projectTasks = new GlideAggregate(taskType);
    projectTasks.addQuery(field, sysId);
    projectTasks.addQuery(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.STATE, states);
    projectTasks.addAggregate('COUNT');
    projectTasks.query();
    if (projectTasks.next()) {
        if (projectTasks.getAggregate('COUNT') > 0)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getPlanningAttributesOfTable = (table) => {
    const tablePlanningAttributes = [];
    const attributes = new sn_plng_att_core.PlanningAttributesService().getPlanningAttributesForRM() || [];

    Object.values(attributes).forEach(value => {
        tablePlanningAttributes.push(value.fieldOnLookupTables[table]);
    });

    return tablePlanningAttributes;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.buildColumnValueObject = (columns, valueObj, columnValueMap) => {
    const gdt = new GlideDateTime();
    const excludedColumns = [ProjectWorkspaceConstants.DEPENDENCY, ProjectWorkspaceConstants.RESOURCE_COLUMN, 'resource_allocation'];
    let mapObj = {}, internalColumn, name, type, value, duration;

    for (let i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {
        internalColumn = columns[i].internalColumnName;
        name = columns[i].name;
        type = columns[i].type;
        mapObj = valueObj[name];

        if (!internalColumn || excludedColumns.indexOf(internalColumn) != -1 || !mapObj)
            continue;

        if (internalColumn.equals(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.RESOURCE_ASSIGNEE_LIST) && mapObj.length == 0) {
			columnValueMap[ProjectWorkspaceConstants.RESOURCE_ASSIGNEE] = "";
			columnValueMap[ProjectWorkspaceConstants.GROUP_RESOURCE_ASSIGNEE] = "";
			continue;
		}

        if (type != null && (type.equals(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.DATE_TIME))) {
            gdt.setDisplayValueInternal(mapObj.value);
            columnValueMap[internalColumn] = mapObj.displayValue ? gdt.getValue() : null;
        } else if ((internalColumn.equals(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.DURATION) ||
                internalColumn.equals(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.WORK_DURATION) ||
                ((internalColumn.equals(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.EFFORT) || internalColumn.equals(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.WORK_EFFORT)) && 
				!type.equals(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.NUMBER))) && mapObj.value) {
            value = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.fetchDurationValue(mapObj.value);
            duration = new GlideDuration(value);
            columnValueMap[internalColumn] = duration.getValue();
        } else if (internalColumn.equals(ProjectWorkspaceConstants.RESOURCE_ASSIGNEE_LIST)) {
            const {
                userIds,
                groupIds
            } = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.breakDownResourceAssigneeList(mapObj);
            columnValueMap[ProjectWorkspaceConstants.RESOURCE_ASSIGNEE] = userIds;
            columnValueMap[ProjectWorkspaceConstants.GROUP_RESOURCE_ASSIGNEE] = groupIds;
        } else
			columnValueMap[internalColumn] = (mapObj.value != null) ? mapObj.value.toString() : (mapObj.toString() || '');
    }
    return columnValueMap;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.breakDownResourceAssigneeList = (taskResourceList) => {
    var userIds = [];
    var groupIds = [];
    taskResourceList.forEach((resource) => {
        if (resource.type == 'group') {
            groupIds.push(resource.id);
        } else
            userIds.push(resource.id);
    });

    return {
        userIds: userIds.join(','),
        groupIds: groupIds.join(',')
    };
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.fetchDurationValue = (duration) => {
    const regExp = /[a-zA-Z]/g;
    if (regExp.test(duration))
        return ProjectWorkspaceUtil.convertDurationValue(duration);

    return duration + ':00'; //adding the seconds part to the duration
};

// Converts duration displayValue to value (2 days 4 minutes -> 2 00:04:00)
ProjectWorkspaceUtil.convertDurationValue = (displayValue) => {
    let dayPart = 0,
        minPart = 0,
        hourPart = 0,
        durationArray = displayValue.split(' ');
    for (let i = 1; i < durationArray.length; i++) {
        if (parseInt(durationArray[i]))
            continue;
        if (durationArray[i] == ProjectWorkspaceConstants.DAY || durationArray[i] == ProjectWorkspaceConstants.DAYS)
            dayPart = durationArray[i - 1];
        else if (durationArray[i] == ProjectWorkspaceConstants.HOUR || durationArray[i] == ProjectWorkspaceConstants.HOURS)
            hourPart = durationArray[i - 1];
        else if (durationArray[i] == ProjectWorkspaceConstants.MINUTE || durationArray[i] == ProjectWorkspaceConstants.MINUTES)
            minPart = durationArray[i - 1];
    }
    const timePart = hourPart + ':' + minPart + ':00';

    return dayPart + ' ' + timePart;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getRecord = (table, id) => {
    const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
    gr.get('sys_id', id);
    return gr;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getUserOrGroupRecords = (resourceIds, tableName, resourceAssigneesMap) => {
    var resourceList = [];
    if (resourceIds && resourceIds.length) {
        var avatharApi = new Avathar();
        var gr = new GlideRecord(tableName);
        gr.addQuery("sys_id", "IN", resourceIds);
        gr.query();
        const resourceType = tableName == 'sys_user_group' ? 'group' : 'user';
        while (gr.next()) {
            const resource = {
                id: gr.getValue('sys_id'),
                value: gr.getValue('sys_id'),
                displayValue: gr.getValue('name'),
                label: gr.getValue('name'),
                imageSrc: avatharApi.get(gr.getValue('sys_id')),
                type: resourceType
            };
            resourceAssigneesMap.set(resource.id, resource);
            resourceList.push(resource);
        }
    }
    return resourceList;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.projectHasClassicRP = function(taskId) {
    var rp = new GlideRecord("resource_plan");
    rp.addQuery("resource_type", "!=", "attribute");
    rp.addQuery("task", taskId).addOrCondition("top_task", taskId);
    rp.setLimit(1);
    rp.query();
    return rp.hasNext();
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getDateTimeFormat = function() {
    let dateTimeFormat = gs.getDateTimeFormat();
    const dateFormat = gs.getDateFormat();
    const dateFormatLength = dateFormat.length;
    dateTimeFormat = dateTimeFormat.substring(0, dateFormatLength).toUpperCase() + dateTimeFormat.substring(dateFormatLength);
    return dateTimeFormat;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getGlideDate = (dateString, isDisplayValue) => {
    const glideDate = new GlideDate();
    if (isDisplayValue)
        glideDate.setDisplayValue(dateString);
    else
        glideDate.setValue(dateString);
    return glideDate;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getGlideDateTime = (dateTimeString /* string */ , isDisplayValue) => {
    const glideDateTime = new GlideDateTime();
    if (isDisplayValue)
        glideDateTime.setDisplayValue(dateTimeString);
    else
        glideDateTime.setValue(dateTimeString);
    return glideDateTime;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil._getErrorOrInfoMessages = (messages, messageArr) => {
    if (messages && messages.length) {
        for (let err in messages) {
            messageArr.push({
                'message': messages[err]
            });
        }
    }
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getErrorMessages = () => {
    const msg = [];
    let errMessage = gs.getErrorMessages();
    ProjectWorkspaceUtil._getErrorOrInfoMessages(errMessage, msg);
    return msg;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getInfoMessages = () => {
    const msg = [];
    let infoMessage = global.PTGlobalAPI.getInfoMessages();
    ProjectWorkspaceUtil._getErrorOrInfoMessages(infoMessage, msg);
    return msg;
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.removeRelAttributeAndQuotes = str => {
    const regex = / rel=".*?"/g;
    return str.replace(regex, '').replace(/"/g, '');
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.decodeHtmlEntityNumbers = encodedString => {
	const entities = {
		'<': '<',
		'>': '>',
		'&': '&',
		'"': '"',
		''': "'",
	};
	const afterEntitiesDecode = encodedString.replace(/&[a-z]+;/g, match => entities[match] || match);
    return afterEntitiesDecode.replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (match, dec) => String.fromCharCode(dec));
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.removeHtmlTags = htmlString => {
	return htmlString.replace(/<\/?[^>]+(>|$)/g, "");
};

ProjectWorkspaceUtil.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    type: 'ProjectWorkspaceUtil'
};]]></script>
